description: codebase-kg hooks. (1) A PreToolUse search gate: the first Grep/Glob (or shell grep/rg/find) of a session is denied with the instruction to query the code graph first, then the gate stands down for that session — any codebase-kg MCP call stands it down too. (2) A PostToolUse nudge on Edit/Write/MultiEdit that reminds you to run /codebase-kg:refresh when you edit source no node anchors on, and periodically once enough mapped files have changed. Both honor .claude/codebase-kg.local.md (search_gate, gate_shell_search, post_edit_nudge, nudge_every, root, graph_path) and SKIP_KG, and both no-op when the repo has no graph.
